subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: After the gateway has accepted a run and the CLI connection drops non-transiently, should the CLI immediately rerun on a fresh session or first recover the authoritative gateway run?
rationale: Both choices are implementable, but they intentionally trade terminal continuity against duplicated model calls, tool side effects, and possible message delivery; repository policy treats fallback behavior as a product decision.

options.title: Land narrow containment
options.body: Confirm fresh-session rerun as the current policy, require the import cycle to be removed, and leave reattach-first recovery to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200.

options.title: Require reattach-first now
options.body: Expand this PR to await the accepted gateway run before using fresh-session embedded fallback as a bounded last resort.

options.title: Pause for recovery design
options.body: Hold this PR until the authoritative result-recovery and delivery semantics are settled together.

recommendation.title: Land narrow containment
recommendation.body: Confirm fresh-session rerun as the current policy, require the import cycle to be removed, and leave reattach-first recovery to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes user-visible CLI recovery semantics and spans command, gateway, delivery, and session ownership rather than being a purely mechanical patch choice.
